review.scope: static installer/profile audit and lifecycle/display acceptance plan

source.hash_capture_note: Hashes were captured during the initial static read. Shared worktree changes to AGENTS.md and docs/LESSONS_LEARNED.md appeared later during concurrent root work; product source and installer hashes were rechecked and match.

installer_static_findings.interpretation: Installer source has no project-defined profile deletion; profile retention expectation is static only until lifecycle test.

profile_static_findings.device_identity_policy: reuse valid UUID v4; atomically create/recreate when missing or invalid
profile_static_findings.bootstrap_seed_policy: create system.xml and cec-driver\cancel only when missing

isolation_environment.note: Hypervisor presence alone does not establish an available isolated VM. No feature/service was installed or started.

in_place_upgrade.required_environment: isolated VM with exact prior installer and profile canary

uninstall.required_environment: isolated VM with installed candidate and profile canary

reinstall.required_environment: isolated VM retaining profile after uninstall

prerequisites: sample top/edge video region and fullscreen bounds
fullscreen_edge_and_round_corner_observa.historical_corner_defect_evidence: REPRODUCIBLE / DEFERRED: windowed is rounded and fullscreen square before playback; after playback starts, fullscreen incorrectly becomes rounded.
fullscreen_edge_and_round_corner_observa.historical_top_strip_evidence: Separate issue; does not substitute for dynamic corner reproduction.
fullscreen_edge_and_round_corner_observa.corner_root_cause: Playback surface top-level window DWM corner state not synchronized with mainWindow fullscreen is a strong suspicion, not a confirmed cause.
fullscreen_edge_and_round_corner_observa.observation_prerequisite: Confirm window identity and observe DWM state in visible foreground before implementation.

evidence_boundary: Historical candidate results are not current-HEAD acceptance. unavailable/not_found are not recorded as false.
